decisions.statement: A passage under a key of its own is the text that key states.
A passage under a record is the text a named field of that record states.
The record worked is the one whose field states the words handed in.
A key the page states no text under is refused.
A key with no record is refused.
Text no record states under that field is refused.
Text more than one record states under that field is refused.
That refusal says how many records state it.
A passage already stating what was asked for is refused.
One passage refused refuses every passage in that body.
The text is written back quoted.
The object read is the object the first exported declaration has.
A body is parsed once however many passages that body states.
Every passage restated in one body answers one edit over the lines those passages sit between.
A body with no passage to restate answers no edit.
Nothing here reads the disk or the index.
Nothing here says which passages are restated.

definition: the edits restating the prose passages one page's body states
